2607.08946.title: Training, Reading, and Editing Legible Transformers
2607.08946.paper_summary: A transformer can be built from operators that are legible by construction -- bounded, named units that read as fuzzy set operations rather than dense activations -- but legibility must be pressed for during training, and the pressure has a failure mode. A crispness penalty meant to sharpen a bounded operator into a decisive detector instead collapses it into a dead constant. An identity, E[v(1-v)] = mu(1-mu) - var, shows why -- the penalty is a variance-minimizer blind to the difference between a live detector and a constant -- and names the fix: a per-channel variance floor, the target legibility metric written as a loss, which recovers both legibility and quality. A learned per-unit fraction then retires the hand-set reserved-GELU partition of prior work: given the choice the model keeps no unit as pure GELU and routes 87% of its load-bearing computation through crisp operators. The result is the most legible transformer we have built -- 78% of its feed-forward operands and 50% of its attention value channels are crisp-and-contextual detectors, and per-head legibility rises from 18% in shallow layers to 78% in deep ones. Read in the correct rotated per-layer frame, these units separate a clean detection (what a unit responds to) from a harder naming (what its output decodes to); and because the objective makes each unit crisp and sparse, edits to them are far more local -- 50-184x in the deep layers where the edit sites concentrate -- and can target explicit conjunctions a single neuron cannot express. Finally, a between-unit decorrelation pressure exposes a legibility dial: it trades a circuit's reuse for independence at no quality cost, turning concepts into single, surgically editable units and a prediction into a short explanation read off a handful of named operations. Quality holds at parity with a conventional baseline throughout.
2607.08946.paper_summary_zh: Transformer可以由在結構上可讀的運算元構建而成——有界的、命名的單元，這些單元被視為模糊集合運算而非密集激活——但在訓練過程中必須強調可讀性，這種壓力有失敗模式。旨在將有界運算元鋒利化為決定性檢測器的清晰度懲罰，反而將其壓縮為一個死常數。一個身份，E[v(1-v)] = mu(1-mu) - var，顯示了原因——這個懲罰是一個對於活檢測器和常數之間差異視而不見的方差最小化器——並命名了解決方案：每通道的方差下限，目標可讀性指標以損失的形式寫出，這恢復了可讀性和質量。學習的每單位分數隨後取代了先前工作的手動設置保留-GELU分區：在選擇的情況下，模型不保留任何單元作為純GELU，並將87%的承載計算通過清晰運算元進行路由。結果是我們所構建的最可讀的Transformer——其前饋運算元的78%和注意力值通道的50%是清晰且具上下文的檢測器，且每頭的可讀性從淺層的18%上升到深層的78%。在正確旋轉的每層框架中閱讀時，這些單元將乾淨的檢測（單元響應的內容）與更困難的命名（其輸出解碼的內容）分開；並且因為目標使每個單元都變得清晰且稀疏，對它們的編輯變得更加局部——在編輯位置集中於深層時，達到50-184倍——並且可以針對單個神經元無法表達的明確聯結。最後，單元之間的去相關壓力揭示了一個可讀性調節器：它以不降低質量的方式交換電路的重用以獲得獨立性，將概念轉化為單一的、可手術編輯的單元，並將預測轉化為從少數命名操作中讀出的簡短解釋。質量在整個過程中與傳統基線保持平行。
2607.08946.author: Mark Oskin et.al.
